'''Nightcrawlers Squad''' was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Special Forces]] [[Squad/Legends|squad]]. Comprised of ten elite [[Infiltrators/Legends|Infiltrators]], the squad was armed with [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistols]] and one member carried a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]].
